description: "Balance of Power: Late Edition" focuses on the intersection of politics and global business. On today's show, Rep. Raja Krishnamoorthi (D-IL) shares his thoughts on President Trump removing Pam Bondi as Attorney General, and if she will appear for testimony in Congress later this month. Dave Aronberg, Managing Partner of Dave Aronberg Law, weighs in on President Trump's ousting of Pam Bondi as Attorney General, warning successors may face the same pressure to target political enemies. Emily Harding, Vice President of the Defense and Security Department at CSIS, discusses risks to regional energy infrastructure and US strategy for monitoring Tehran's nuclear program. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Removes Bondi After Chaotic DOJ Tenure | Balance of Power: Late Edition 04/02/2026

author: Chris Strohm, Jimmy Jenkins
description: President Donald Trump’s decision to remove Pam Bondi as attorney general delivers a new disruption to an already embattled US Justice Department as it works to advance the administration’s policy goals and sometimes controversial prosecutions.
title: Trump Turns to Ally Todd Blanche to Steer DOJ Through Fresh Tumult

description: Emily Harding, Vice President of the Defense and Security Department at CSIS, says restoring shipping through the Strait of Hormuz depends on whether Iran steps back, regardless of US actions. She also discusses risks to regional energy infrastructure and US strategy for monitoring Tehran's nuclear program. She speaks with Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Harding Says Hormuz Reopening Hinges on Iran

description: Dave Aronberg, Managing Partner of Dave Aronberg Law, weighs in on President Trump's ousting of Pam Bondi as Attorney General, warning successors may face the same pressure to target political enemies. He discusses Bondi's next move, and the DOJ's relationship with the White House under President Trump. He speaks with Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Attorney: Bondi Ousting Reflects Trump's AG Expectations

description: Rep. Raja Krishnamoorthi (D-IL) shares his thoughts on President Trump removing Pam Bondi as Attorney General, and if she will appear for testimony in Congress later this month. He shares that Bondi has “a lot of explaining to do,” and needs to be held accountable in regards to her handling of the Epstein files. He also discusses the ongoing partial shutdown and if he sees an end approaching soon. Representative Krishnamoorthi speaks with Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg’s “Balance of Power.” (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Rep. Krishnamoorthi on Bondi Ousting, DHS Shutdown

description: Attorney General Pam Bondi is leaving after a tumultuous tenure and some high-profile stumbles in her efforts to carry out President Donald Trump’s agenda Trump announced in a social media post Bondi would move to “a much needed and important job in the private sector” and her deputy, Todd Blanche, will be acting attorney general. Trump called Bondi “a Great American Patriot and a loyal friend” and applauded her work to drive down crime. He said her next position will be “announced at a date in the near future.” Jason Leopold, BN Senior Investigative Reporter & FOIA Files newsletter Author  joins to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Says Bondi Out, Blanche Stepping In
